notes: Pilot reports are biased toward where aircraft fly and toward reporting bumps rather than smooth air.
Positive = moderate or greater (code >= 4); negative = light or less (code <= 2); light-moderate (3) is not scored.
Lead = valid time minus the time the forecast was sealed. Scoreboard row 'at least k h' uses, for each report, the latest record sealed at least k hours before the valid time.
The backtest uses hindsight fields (analysis-time comparison of indices), not forecasts; only these live sealed forecasts test forecast skill.
A hit means the sealed risk at the report was in the top 20% of that forecast's grid at the report's level.
Records are graded 75 minutes after their valid hour, with report layers within 30 minutes of it, and only once the report store covers that whole window; uncovered records wait.
A grade formed from incomplete reports may be corrected once in regrades.jsonl (the original grade line is kept); scores use the corrected truth.
Backtest (hindsight fields): SeedBlend and Ellrod1 are not separated: the day-block interval for the difference in AUC (-0.004 to +0.024) includes zero.
